items.verbatim_snippet: In September 2024, Ontario's Ministry of Health appointed David Musyj — then serving as LHSC's Acting/Interim President and CEO (a role he'd held since May 2024, seconded from Windsor Regional Hospital) — as formal Supervisor of LHSC under the Public Hospitals Act.
